name: Pilihan Aman — Amber on Ink (v2 big-tech calm, approved 2026-11-05)
rules: One accent only: amber. For key numbers, the live dot, matrix peaks, focus.
Status colours stay muted: sage = calibrated / grade A / hit; amber = partial / grade B; brick = not calibrated / grade C / miss.
No gradients, glow, or neon. No boxes or bordered panels — structure comes from spacing, alignment, and type; hairlines stay very faint and only where a table needs separation.
Numbers always in IBM Plex Mono, tabular. Labels are quiet sentence case — no all-caps, no stamps.
Type is one family: Archivo (600 for display, tight tracking; 400/500 for text).
